name: P.W. Project Witch
source: The protagonist is a 4th grader with troubles socializing with his peers. However his life will change when he receives a package from the "House of Dolls"... a girl his age from a world of magic that's doing a homestay with him! The protagonist will help her grow and progress her powers.
translation: 主人公是个不擅长与同龄人交往的小学四年级学生。然而，收到“人偶之家”寄来的包裹后，他的生活即将改变…包裹里竟是一名来自魔法世界、与他同龄的女孩，她要寄宿在他家！主人公将帮助她成长，提升魔法能力。
